correctness.rationale: The proof establishes a unique greedy prefix-matching state path, with at most one increment per antichain level; stay levels have exactly one allowed all-complement assignment and increment levels exactly 2^{n_i}-1 assignments. This gives a disjoint weighted-subset bijection and all-parameter formula. Independent exhaustive chain-level checks agreed on 141 profiles and 26,939 colorings, including every k through h. Finite checks are corroboration, not the general proof.

value.rationale: A natural finite-model predicate counting problem motivated by forbidden alternation in k-monotonicity receives a closed all-k and all-level-size solution, its entire exact alternation-index spectrum, an explicit canonical classification, and the unexpected invariance of those counts under permutation of ordinal levels. This is not a mere finite census: it yields all orders and parameters and a constructive enumeration with polynomial-time arithmetic in the number of levels, with potential use as a benchmark for higher-order-pattern counting and testability.
